entities.summary: Yvonne Farrell is an Irish architect and academic. She is the co-founder, together with Shelley McNamara, of Grafton Architects, which won the World Building of the Year award in 2008 for their Bocconi University building in Milan. The practice won the inaugural RIBA International Prize in 2016 for their Universidad de Ingeniería y Tecnología building in Lima, Peru, and was awarded the 2020 Royal Gold Medal. In 2017 she was appointed, along with Shelley McNamara, as curator of the 16th Venice Biennale of Architecture in 2018. She won the Pritzker Architecture Prize in 2020, also with McNamara.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Yvonne Farrell's work as co-founder of Grafton Architects has had significant regional impact through her winning projects in Lima and Milan, contributing to a shift in architectural thinking. Her Pritzker Architecture Prize in 2020 further solidified her influence.
